records.text: An unnamed officer, quoted from a search warrant by Owens, reported finding a Google Maps route on Tyler Robinson’s cell phone with a 6:46 p.m. universal start time, approximately 12:46 local time and 23 minutes after the shooting, from near Mountain Shadows Shopping Center to Quick Quack Car Wash.
records.speaker: Search-warrant narrating officer (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: It says a search warrant was obtained for Tyler Robinson's cell phone. And during a review of data and information stored on the device, the officer is saying, I observed a Google Maps route with a start time of 646 universal p.m. Accounting for the time conversion, it was approximately at 1246. ... The route start time was approximately 23 minutes after the shooting. The starting point for the route was listed with GPS coordinates. ... The starting point coordinates were near the Mountain Shadow Shopping Center. According to Google Maps, the shopping center is approximately seven minutes from the Utah Valley University. ... The Google Maps route is from the area near the shopping complex to a Quick Quack Car Wash.
